cnpcgeckoaddon.sound.ticks_hint: 20 ticks = 1 second. Uses Warden vibration rules.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.bar_scale_hint: Percent of the style's normal size.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.phase_threshold_hint: Lands between %s and %s, the window the phases either side leave.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.area_vfx_hint: Cosmetic only: the arena is never damaged.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.enemies_hint: The attack only hits enemies available to the boss.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.projectile_hint: Uses the NPC's standard ranged projectile settings.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.ability_target_hint: Nearest/farthest/random pick from this set. "Everything alive" also picks up passing animals.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.phase_count_hint: Each phase keeps its own abilities and animations.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.minions_hint: Only affects clones this boss summoned itself.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.minions_reset_hint: The reset delay is configured under Fight reset.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.reset_hint: Resetting rolls back the phase, minions and timers.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.home_leash_hint: Leaving this radius ends the encounter; Reset heal/return still apply.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.home_leash_teleport_: Boss teleport points are checked too.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.rage_hint: Doubles damage, attack rate, knockback and speed. Health is untouched.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.tuning_hint: Defaults are exactly the old behaviour.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.tuning.totem_fit_hei: Totem box height (tenths of a block)
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.tuning.totem_fit_hal: Totem box half-width (tenths of a block)
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.tuning.lethal_guard: Killing blow leaves (tenths of a heart point)
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.tuning.corridor_spee: Corridor front (tenths of a block a tick)
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.health_link_hint: Bosses of one group in range share the link; a partner in an unloaded chunk does not count. Give partners the same reset rules.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.explosion_hint: Plays the model death animation, then detonates.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.telegraph_announce: Name it in the action bar
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.telegraph_hint: The warning lasts exactly as long as the wind-up.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.telegraph_lead_hint: Counted together with the wind-up, so the animation stays in sync.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.telegraph_dodge_hint: The ability is cancelled if the target got out in time.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.telegraph_line_lasti: Lines for fuses and edges too
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.telegraph_line_hint: Lines follow the floor like the dust does; a hole breaks them the same way.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.effect_hint: 20 ticks = 1 second. Applies even if the damage was blocked.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.effect_fire_hint: cnpcgeckoaddon:fire sets the victim on fire for the duration; the level multiplies the burn.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.capture_hint: Effects apply as soon as the player is caught.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.leap_hint: The boss takes no fall damage from its own leap.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.line_hint: The side wave hits softer than the corridor itself.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.geyser_hint: The fuse is the window to step out of it.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.geyser_residue_hint: Standing in the residue stacks its potions; step out and the stacks fade.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.boulder_hint: Cosmetic block: it never breaks the arena.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.boulder_style_hint: Shards still come from the block above, so pick a matching one.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.boulder_rain_hint: The mark burns until the stone lands - height sets the warning.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.boulder_rain_min_dro: Skip under a roof closer than (tenths)
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.tether_hint: Run past the break distance before the timer ends.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.gravity_hint: Pull: sprint away or get eaten. Fling: brace for the landing.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.gravity_strength_uni: Strength: pull in hundredths, lift in tenths
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.mark_hint: Gather: share it. Spread: carry it away from everyone.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.cover_hint: The wind-up is the only warning: make it long enough to run.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.hazard_hint: Ring: outside hurts. Box: inside hurts. Resets with the phase.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.hunt_hint: Kite it: the boss ignores everyone else until time runs out.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.barrier_hint: A damage check: burn the shield in time or pay for it.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.beam_hint: Walk with the spin, or hide behind a pillar.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.beam_look_hint: Changes the particles only; the wind-up warning keeps the ability colour.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.cocoon_hint: Someone has to come for you. Make the guard optional, not the rescue.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.dash_stop_on_hit: Stops at the first one hit
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.dash_hint: Step out of the lane, or make it run into a wall.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.cone_hint: Step out of the sector; with points the boss sweeps them one by one.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.cone_dodge.sector: Cancels when the target leaves the fan
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.cone_dodge.range: Cancels when the target gets out of range
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.cone_needs_victim: Only if someone is in the fan
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.cone_series_hint: A series of N points at T ticks holds the boss for N × T ticks.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.cone_tuning_hint: The old rules: dodging cancels out of range, the cooldown counts from the wind-up.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.platform_hint: Jump to another platform before the countdown ends.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.platform_tuning_hint: Set the densities and the pillars to 0 for the old sparse look.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.hurricane_hint: A storm keeps whoever it catches; step off its path or wait it out.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.shadow_finale_at.rec: On the next cast of this ability
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.shadow_hide_bar: Hide the boss bar while copies live
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.shadow_clear_phase: A phase change removes the copies
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.shadow_hint: A copy is a second npc just like the boss: its own health, its own hits; the bar and the encounter belong to the real one.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.seismic_random: Random: rings per pulse, min / max
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.seismic_height: Wave height above the floor (tenths, 0 = any)
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.seismic_random_pulse: Random: pulses per series (0 = one per ring)
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.seismic_random_core: Random may pick the core circle
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.seismic_root: Boss stands still while the series runs
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.seismic_slam_fall: Slam landing takes fall damage too
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.seismic_hint: The rings run along the floor: jump over a wave or step past its edge.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.rift_arena.prebuilt: Built by hand at the spot
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.rift_abilities_title: Reality rift - what the boss may cast meanwhile
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.rift_abilities_hint: + cast while the rift is open, - not. With nothing marked the boss only stands and waits.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.rift_minions_hint: Stood up when the way out is to kill the rift's minions. An offset point counts from the platform's centre, a fixed one is a spot in the rift dimension; with no points they stand on a ring round the centre.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.rift_fail_hint: A rift fails when its limit runs out first, or when everyone taken died. The enrage needs the boss' rage timer switched on; the potions land even with no damage.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.rift_hint: The taken players do the task in the rift; the boss stands and waits.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.cast_move_hint: Standing still keeps the warning zone honest. Facing is never locked.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.cast_spot_hint: The boss goes there first, casts, and holds the spot while the ability lasts.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.finish_hint: While a marked ability lasts, and for the hold after it, the boss starts nothing else: no cast, no path hop, no cast spot.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.finish_hint_instant: An instant ability has nothing to wait for: its hold is the whole wait, so mark it with a number.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.combo_hint: The next ability fires when this one ends, even if it is switched off; only its setup has to be filled in.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.invulnerable_hint: Only summons run, then the next phase starts.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.chest_hint: Contents are deleted with the chest when the time runs out.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.aggro_zone_hint: Entering the box starts the encounter.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.aggro_zone_exclusive: Zone is the only way in
Targets outside the box are dropped at once; hits from outside are turned away.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.health_scaling_hint_: The first player uses base HP;
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.minion_spawn_hint: Each configured point can use its own clone.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.minion_spawn_arena_h: Offset from boss position at load.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.totem_hold: Totems hold the boss in place
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.totem_hint: The boss is protected while any linked totem lives.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.totem_hold_hint: While any ward totem stands, the boss cannot move or teleport.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.totem_silence_hint: While any ward totem stands: no casts of its own, no being picked by others; cooldowns keep ticking.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.totem_beam_width_hin: 0 is the shared width; anything else lands between 25 and 400.
cnpcgeckoaddon.boss.totem_vuln_hint: With an empty list the totem cannot be broken at all.
cnpcgeckoaddon.model_picker.title: Select GeckoLib model
cnpcgeckoaddon.carry.on: Carry mode on: right-click an npc to pick it up
cnpcgeckoaddon.carry.busy: Someone is already carrying that npc
cnpcgeckoaddon.carry.returned: Returned %s to where it was picked up
cnpcgeckoaddon.carry.too_far: It slipped out of your hands
cnpcgeckoaddon.carry.title: Carrying
cnpcgeckoaddon.carry.hint: Sneak-click keeps normal right-click free for dialogue.
cnpcgeckoaddon.carry.throw_hint: Right-click into the air or at a mob throws it; a block still places it.
death.attack.cnpcgeckoaddon.thrown_npc: %1$s was flattened by a thrown npc
death.attack.cnpcgeckoaddon.thrown_npc.i: %1$s was flattened by a thrown npc
cnpcgeckoaddon.npc.tuning_hint: Defaults are exactly the old behaviour.
cnpcgeckoaddon.npc.immunity_hint: Checked abilities pass this npc by entirely: no damage, no effects, no pull.
cnpcgeckoaddon.npc.immunity_blast_hint: Blast immunity covers any explosion, not only the boss one.
cnpcgeckoaddon.npc.resist_hint: First match wins. 100 = normal, 0 = immune. Applies on top of the CustomNPCs resistances.
cnpcgeckoaddon.launch.title: Launch pad
cnpcgeckoaddon.launch.grace: No fall damage for (ticks after flight)
cnpcgeckoaddon.launch.hint: Lands on the block set here. Spawn it with the boss' summon points to time it.
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.damageinfo_on: Damage info on: hit an npc to see its source id
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.guards_none: No guarded failures since the start or the last reset
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.guards_header: Guarded failures at %s places (the whole stacks are in the log):
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.guards_reset: Guard counters reset; the next failure anywhere is logged at once
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.selftest_armed: Self test '%s' armed: %s. Watch the log for one ERROR line with a stack - the game carries on.
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.selftest_scheduler: the boss schedulers of %s fail on their next tick and drop this level's geysers
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.selftest_damage: the next hit you take fails the addon's damage handler and lands the vanilla way
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.selftest_packet: a packet sent to your client fails in its handler (the line is in the client's log)
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.selftest_client: your client's next tick fails once (the line is in the client's log)
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.selftest_controller: the controller of %s fails every tick: its fight resets after 10 s and it is disabled until reload after 20 s
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.selftest_no_boss: No boss with a running controller within %s blocks
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.rift_no_dimension: The reality rift dimension is not loaded in this world
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.rift_tp_failed: Could not take you to the rift dimension - are you in a rift already?
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.rift_tp: Taken to the rift at %s %s %s; /cnpcgecko rift return brings you back
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.rift_return: Returned %s players stranded in the rift
cnpcgeckoaddon.cmd.rift_build: Built the platform of slot %s at %s %s %s, radius %s
cnpcgeckoaddon.model.no_recorded_size: No model size; manual values apply
cnpcgeckoaddon.string_picker.hunt_mark_e: Selecting the mark on the prey:
cnpcgeckoaddon.cue.unknown_id: Unknown id, kept the previous one
cnpcgeckoaddon.cue.hint: Any registered id works; "dust" is the ability's own colour.
cnpcgeckoaddon.ranged_extras.projectile_: Only projectile entities work; anything else is dropped on save with a line in the log.
cnpcgeckoaddon.ranged_extras.fallback_hi: Fired when the chosen entity is not a projectile and the npc has no projectile item; empty = no shot.
